sheets.title: Settings › General › Push, before the key is pressed — phone
sheets.caption: A guest with a live Identity session in a browser that can receive push: the Push row, Off, with its one key. Both builds walk to the same screen; the row itself did not change.
sheets.before: row key "Turn on push on this device"; browser subscribed 0; Identity API holds 0
sheets.after: row key "Turn on push on this device"; browser subscribed 0; Identity API holds 0

sheets.title: The Push row after the key is pressed — phone
sheets.caption: The same press against the same live Identity API. Before, the enrolment was refused by this installation's own egress port (the purpose it asked under was misspelt), so nothing ever left the page.
sheets.before: row still Off (key "Turn on push on this device"); browser subscribed 0; Identity API holds 0
sheets.after: row On (key "Turn off push on this device"); browser subscribed 1; Identity API holds 1

sheets.title: The notification tray after that press — phone
sheets.caption: What the tray says about the press.
sheets.before: 1 notice: "The sign-in service is not reachable from here, so notifications were not changed." (it was never asked)

sheets.title: An account at its subscription limit — phone
sheets.caption: The principal already holds ten subscriptions (the service's limit); this press is the eleventh.
sheets.before: 1 notice: "The sign-in service is not reachable from here, so notifications were not changed."; browser subscribed 0
sheets.after: 1 notice: "The server refused that (409)."; browser subscribed 1 and taken back 1; Identity API still holds 10

sheets.title: An operator policy that does not name the Identity API — phone
sheets.caption: The deployment's policy allows one service origin, and it is not the Identity API's. The refusal is this installation's, and now says so.
sheets.before: 1 notice: "The sign-in service is not reachable from here, so notifications were not changed."
sheets.after: 1 notice: "This installation may not reach the sign-in service for push (origin-not-allowed), so notifications were not changed."; no request left, browser subscribed 0
